autismosupremo112: Teodor Autismosupre was a carpenter in Wyvern Cross until the posters went up. He came to Q-S8 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts, and within a day the whole squad knew that he can fall asleep anywhere, instantly.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-S8. Teodor Autismosupre has learned to walk bent double.

The men at Q-S8 heard Teodor Autismosupre call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno of the Hegemony (@flamboyantnoble). Teodor Autismosupre was hit at Q-S8 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno of the Hegemony (@flamboyantnoble).

Marek Autismosupre took the same post at Q-S8 where Teodor Autismosupre stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Marek Autismosupre stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Marek Autismosupre. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Marek Autismosupre asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
calmnight_kino: Day 9: Konrad "Owl" Kino reached S-S1 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Konrad "Owl" Kino listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A round went through Konrad "Owl" Kino's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Leopold Falloutcat of the Concord (@falloutcat123). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Konrad "Owl" Kino answered to number 610. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Konrad "Owl" Kino watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Konrad "Owl" Kino's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-S1 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Konrad "Owl" Kino worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
cpurvis_4: Tobias Cpurvis, a lamplighter from Saint-Lune, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in T-F1. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Tobias Cpurvis was hit hard in the fight at T-F1 before anyone could fire. The raider was Albin Weyer of the Hegemony. Raider: Albin Weyer of the Hegemony (@wout.vd.weyer). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Tobias Cpurvis kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Tobias Cpurvis came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Tobias Cpurvis watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

The men at T-F1 heard Tobias Cpurvis call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard). The bearers reached Tobias Cpurvis at T-F1 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard).
Quentin "Tin" Cpurvis put a cracked shaving mirror beside the bunk. Someone who had known Tobias Cpurvis helped clear the shelf without saying why.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Quentin "Tin" Cpurvis left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
hjansen2024: At the depot, Severin Hjansen had practised answering to his name. At R-R6, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-R6 changed before the cheering ended. Severin Hjansen shouldered another load. Severin Hjansen left the work of a runner to become a rifleman. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Severin Hjansen sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Severin Hjansen. Severin Hjansen read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Grey Mill has been won. Severin Hjansen listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Severin Hjansen said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. Mail came up the line with a letter for Severin Hjansen. Severin Hjansen read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Officers came to inspect R-R6. Severin Hjansen polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
hunt_karli: Silas Karli unpacked his brother's pocket watch at S-S5. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
A crow sat on the parapet above Silas Karli all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
Silas Karli (Hegemony) and Edmund Callmequeeno (Concord) came to the same broken well at the Brickworks at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Silas Karli helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Silas Karli fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-S5. Benedikt Manningwam was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Karli. Silas Karli read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Silas Karli answered to number 474. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Silas Karli folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Silas Karli spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.

The relief column arrived early. Silas Karli made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Karli. Silas Karli read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
jacobg31115: By the time Zeno Jacobg reached S-C11, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Zeno Jacobg listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Zeno Jacobg (Hegemony) and Arno Zhar (Concord) came to the same broken well at the Ossuary Wood at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Zeno Jacobg answered to number 938. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Zeno Jacobg shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Felix "Bones" Kurlkale lent Zeno Jacobg a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Zeno Jacobg on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home.
levichapman5: Norbert Levichapman introduced himself as a choir singer from Halden. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Norbert Levichapman's ear at U-F15 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony (@jonesmann829). The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F15. Norbert Levichapman has learned to walk bent double.

A bullet found Norbert Levichapman at U-F15, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito of the Hegemony (@joey_yarrito). Norbert Levichapman was killed outright at U-F15, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito of the Hegemony (@joey_yarrito).
Another member of the House of Levichapman reached the line: Pavel "Spark" Levichapman. He asked where Norbert Levichapman had slept, then chose a different corner.
Pavel "Spark" Levichapman and Nils Lucwar sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
lordfulgrim: At the depot, Casimir Lordfulgrim had practised answering to his name. At T-F20, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

Casimir Lordfulgrim fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Tobias "Smokes" Moitpan, now gravely wounded. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Casimir Lordfulgrim helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Casimir Lordfulgrim aimed a step ahead and fired: Yann Thesenorfry, badly wounded. The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Casimir Lordfulgrim waited for that to change. When it did, Henrik "Hollow" Elm was grazed.
Edmund Forestier and Casimir Lordfulgrim carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
marcille_reenactment_and_meow: Zeno Meow walked into P-F19 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could. The transfer made Zeno Meow a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

New laces made Zeno Meow's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up. A letter from home found Zeno Meow before the night shift. Zeno Meow folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into P-F19. Zeno Meow has learned to walk bent double.
Zeno Meow and Silas Michigangame have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
The relief reached P-F19 without Zeno Meow. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead.
mitch_jns06: Henrik Jns arrived on Day 7 as a replacement. The men in R-S13 had been fighting for 7 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Henrik Jns remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Henrik Jns and Zeno Kallenfultz sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Henrik Jns helped stack spare sandbags at R-S13. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Henrik Jns hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Henrik Jns answered to number 498. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Henrik Jns wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Henrik Jns's hands still remember being a shepherd's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Henrik Jns was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen.
mr_jaxk1: Day 12. The corporal put Gideon "Spark" Jaxk beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Gideon "Spark" Jaxk fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Clement Gagulaa did not get to reply at all, grazed. A bullet went through Gideon "Spark" Jaxk's upper arm at V-F10 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Tobias Historylover of the Concord (@historylover1945). Gideon "Spark" Jaxk was killed outright at V-F10, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Tobias Historylover of the Concord (@historylover1945).
Leopold "Tin" Jaxk arrived carrying the family name of Gideon "Spark" Jaxk. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
rey_rob_ii: Bram "Whistle" Rob signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at Q-F20 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Bram "Whistle" Rob stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Bram "Whistle" Rob fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F20. Ivo Banach was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. After the loss of Grey Mill, Bram "Whistle" Rob helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F20. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Bram "Whistle" Rob asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
Across the wire at Calvary Farm, Wendel Melioduff of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Bram "Whistle" Rob of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
seankukhta: The quartermaster asked Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks.
Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.
Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.

Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Teodor Roos was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@_michael_roos_01) Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Valentin Crobus and Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. The clerk counted the names twice. Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta is number 445 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta felt a hard tug at his hip at R-S11. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Marek "Button" Gergely of the Hegemony (@gergely.v_).
Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta returned to R-S11 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
strange_jesus: The old hands of S-R10 have been here since Day 1. Walter Jesus has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-R10 changed before the cheering ended. Walter Jesus shouldered another load.

Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Walter Jesus could not stop listening to it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Walter Jesus watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The cook borrowed Walter Jesus's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of S-R10. When Walter Jesus challenged it, there was nobody there.
taurineinositol: Day 9. The corporal put Norbert "Mole" Taurineinosi beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Norbert "Mole" Taurineinosi read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Norbert "Mole" Taurineinosi and Dorian Spencerbonth made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Norbert "Mole" Taurineinosi kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Norbert "Mole" Taurineinosi shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Norbert "Mole" Taurineinosi carried hot tea up to the front line in petrol cans. Everyone could taste the petrol. Everyone drank it.
vinski_jokinen86: The sergeant gave Karel Jokinen a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.

Karel Jokinen was hit in the forearm at S-R16. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Gideon Sam of the Concord (@fenley_sam). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Karel Jokinen shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

The wound on Karel Jokinen's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Karel Jokinen did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Karel Jokinen could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water.
Karel Jokinen found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
